data.title: 银镜伊织 · 审判长靴褪下的羞耻烙印
data.action: 端坐在金属折叠椅上，一手死死拽着睡裙领口，赤裸的修长深色双足踩在冰冷瓷砖上，银发双马尾低垂，紫红眼眸水汽氤氲地瞪着老师。
data.location: 格黑娜风纪委员会值班休息室，脱下的黑色战术长靴整齐立在墙角
data.timeOfDay: 深夜校园巡逻归来的私密处分
data.lighting: 值班室清冷的日光灯管从头顶投下，将银色发丝与小麦色肌肤的光泽表现得淋漓尽致
data.mood: 严格风纪委员长被撞见私服的极致羞耻与反差萌，傲娇到极点的诱惑
data.description: 格黑娜风纪委员会值班休息室，脱下的黑色战术长靴整齐立在墙角。端坐在金属折叠椅上，一手死死拽着睡裙领口，赤裸的修长深色双足踩在冰冷瓷砖上，银发双马尾低垂，紫红眼眸水汽氤氲地瞪着老师。 她微微抬眸轻语——“老师……！你、你往哪里看呢！不准看我的脚……！再敢提出奇怪的舔靴子要求，我现在就开枪击毙你！”
data.promptProse: Caught off-duty in the Gehenna Prefect Team break room late at night with her heavy black tactical boots set neatly by the wall, Iori sits upright on a metal folding chair in her black ribbed three-snap bralette and snug boyleg shorts. Clutching defensively at her neckline with bare feet pressed against the cool tile floor, she glares down with a furious, mortified blush and watery eyes. Crisp overhead fluorescent light gleams over her taut dark skin and silver hair.
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot on a duty-room folding chair with her combat boots set aside, Iori wears a black ribbed three-snap bralette and boyleg shorts while glaring down with a furious crimson blush. Cool overhead office light illuminates her taut stance.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fitted matte-black ribbed tactical bralette with three silver front snaps and snug black boyleg shorts, her tall combat boots removed and set aside.
